performance.note_on_a_performance_fix: an early version followed both direct_dep and rev_dep edges when building the restricted Kconfig cone; for widely-selected symbols (CRC32, USB core, etc.) this pulled in a large fraction of the whole tree and made 5 of the 16 test cases exceed a 45s timeout. Dropping rev_dep-driven expansion (keeping only direct_dep + choice siblings) fixed all 5 to ~1.5-2s with no change in the other 11 cases' results; see the trade-off note in src/cli/commands/_configfor_kconfig.py.
